get_started.title: Get started
get_started.description: Your AI connects and sets up.
get_started.text: Set me up to build for the Rafflex marketplace. Follow __BASE_URL__/start.md step by step.

next_version.title: Next version
next_version.text: Start the next version of {title}. Live is {live_version}.

revert.title: Revert
revert.description: Go back to an earlier version.

get_it_live_first.title: Get it live
get_it_live_first.text: Run verify on {path}, push it as a new product, and submit {version} for review.

get_it_live.title: Get it live
get_it_live.text: Run verify on {slug}, push it, and submit {version} for review with the notes in CHANGELOG.md.

check_review.title: Check the review
check_review.text: Check where the review of {title} {version} stands.

fix_review.title: Fix the review
fix_review.text: Fix what the reviewer asked on {title} and submit {version} again.

new_product_ai_start.title: Let your AI start
new_product_ai_start.text: Run npx @rafflex/dev new {type} "{title}" and build it.
